text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Alright, come at me, hoiza!

Passing near the back of the school building, I spotted
Machikane Tannhauser engaging in what looked like
sumo drills against a nearby tree.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hoiza! ...Ah, hello there!
As you can see, I'm practicing hugging!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you remember?
Before, I hesitated when Taiki-san
tried to give me a hug...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I disliked it!
I fool around and roughhouse with my friends
all the time too...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's just... Taiki-san's hugs are packed with pure
LOVE! There's so much "I love you!" bursting
from her feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, it's like, kuaaah~!
As happy as it makes me, the embarrassment is
doubled!! You know what I mean!?
choice_data_list: I kind of get what you're saying...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So! Just receiving all that affection would be
too ordinary, so I thought I have to return just as
much love right back!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if after catching her, I should spin her
round and round like whoooosh!? Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like this!? Or maybe something like this!?
Atchoo! Dokkoizaaa!

...I think a normal hug would be fine, but
Machikane Tannhauser looks dead serious. Maybe
I should give her some advice...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it! If you don't mind,
would you let me practice with you!?
A hug practice filled with lots of affection!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
After all, with a tree as a partner, I just can't
get the hang of it, or should I say... it doesn't give
any reaction, you know?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, first I need to practice catching someone!
It's pointless unless the other person comes at me!

...Even if she says so. As an adult in an instructor's
position, seeking a loving hug from a student would
definitely be problematic.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, but ask someone else—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't hold back!
Hug me with a big KABOOM!!

If someone overhears this, it'll lead to nothing but
misunderstandings...! I tried to calm her down and talk,
but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh... what are you doing...?

...Too late.
I hurriedly tried to clear up the misunderstanding, but—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's an expression of affection!!

Machikane Tannhauser carried on with full momentum,
making the situation worse without any bad intentions.
Anyway, I have to calm down and explain—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, so that's what it is.
Well, that makes sense. Ah, you startled me...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. I just got so absorbed in it... and before
I knew it.
choice_data_list: Since you're here, why not practice with Mejiro Dober?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ha! That's a great idea! Since we're both Horse Girls,
the momentum and power will be just like the real deal...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you two are roommates, right!?
If so, Dober-san must be totally used to hugs...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-That might be true, but why does that mean
I have to—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's perfect!
Please be my teachaaar~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! Why are you starting to talk like Taiki...!?

The two of them sharing an affectionate(?) hug looked
just like harmless playfulness... but it was a deeply
heartwarming sight.

And so, I explained everything in order from the beginning,
but—

And so, when I explained everything in order from the
beginning—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-That... behind the school building like this...
just sounds like an excuse!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... but just because there aren't many people
around, doing... um... h-hugging in a place like this
is questionable.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haeh? An excuse??

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, I'm sorry...
I got way too serious without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! This kind of thing isn't allowed!
Let's go, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You don't really need to apologize.
Besides... I kind of get that sort of struggle...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry up!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eh, eh, waaaahhh!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: D-Dober-saaaan!?

Pulling Machikane Tannhauser by the hand, Mejiro Dober
left the scene as if running away.

Machikane Tannhauser followed after Mejiro Dober,
who had briskly turned her back and walked away.
...It seems the misunderstanding was not cleared up.
...That was quite a whirlwind.
